description: Publish a specific partial version as the default, unlike update_prompt_partial which creates a new draft without activating it. Use after list_partial_versions to pick a version_id; this immediately changes what {{> partial_name}} resolves to for all prompts and replaces the previously active version without a rollback path.

name: publish_partial
